principles: First-party venue and institution sources are canonical where available.
Automated discovery only runs against sources explicitly marked automationAllowed=true.
Automated discovery records URLs and factual link metadata only; it does not republish page copy or images.
robots.txt and source-specific terms are checked before fetching.
Reference directories can identify gaps in the venue universe but are not automatically ingested when their terms prohibit or restrict reuse.
